Hero.Title: Odoo implementation in geneva for swiss SMEs
Hero.Description: Ark Fiduciaire supports you in the integration, customization, and evolution of your Odoo solution. Optimize your processes, automate tasks, and manage your business with a complete and scalable ERP.

Presentation.Title: Odoo in switzerland: implementation and business modules
Presentation.Subtitle: A complete and scalable ERP solution
Intro: Odoo is a modular and flexible ERP solution, ideal for digitizing and optimizing your business management. Ark Fiduciaire supports you in the integration, customization, and evolution of your Odoo system.
We analyze your needs, configure the right modules, and train your teams to ensure rapid and effective adoption. Our technical support ensures the continuity and security of your Odoo environment.
Your team stays autonomous: automate routine tasks, extract data from invoices and receipts automatically, and build simple reports without IT.
Services: Odoo implementation: complete deployment and configuration of Odoo tailored to your business needs
Process automation: streamlining your workflows with automated administrative and operational tasks
Data migration: seamless transfer of your existing data to the new Odoo system
Training & support: comprehensive user training and ongoing technical assistance
Presentation.StrengthsTitle: Our strengths for your digital transformation

Strengths.Title: Tailored Odoo integration
Strengths.Desc: Deployment, configuration, and customization of the Odoo solution to precisely meet your business needs. We ensure a smooth transition and comprehensive support.

Strengths.Title: Process automation
Strengths.Desc: Optimization of your workflows through the automation of administrative, accounting, sales, or HR tasks via Odoo.

Strengths.Title: Training and support
Strengths.Desc: Support for your teams at every stage: training, technical assistance, and ongoing support to ensure the success of your Odoo project.

Strengths.Title: Security and compliance
Strengths.Desc: Implementation of secure solutions, meeting the confidentiality and compliance standards in force in Switzerland.

Strengths.Title: Consulting and evolution
Strengths.Desc: Our experts advise you on the evolution of your information system and the integration of new Odoo modules as your business grows.

Presentation.LongFormTitle: Detailed approach and deliverables for odoo implementation and business modules

LongFormSections.Title: Scope, objectives and priorities
Body: Our work on odoo implementation and business modules starts with a precise review of your flows and operating model so we can define a clear scope, realistic timeline, and priorities that make a measurable difference. In Geneva, Lausanne and French-speaking Switzerland, we work with SMEs, scale-ups, groups and finance teams who want to secure odoo implementation without adding internal complexity or losing visibility on key decisions. The core deliverables typically cover configuration, migration, training and integrations, with an ongoing focus on data quality and traceability. We embed requirements tied to swiss chart of accounts, VAT and QR invoicing from the beginning to avoid late-stage fixes and compliance risk. Depending on your context, we organize the collection of accounting data, internal processes and business requirements and implement simple routines to keep records complete and reliable.

We rely on odoo, accounting, sales, purchasing modules and dashboards when they add clarity, while staying compatible with your current stack if you prefer a hybrid approach. Every engagement begins with a short diagnostic that clarifies constraints, expected gains, and decision points, then translates into a written action plan. We favor direct communication and regular checkpoints so trade-offs remain visible and timelines stay under control. Our methods adapt to activity cycles, operational peaks, and cantonal constraints, with a pragmatic follow-up rhythm. The goal is to deliver smooth processes, visibility and automation while reducing the administrative load on your teams.

When external stakeholders are involved, we coordinate exchanges and prepare the synthesis materials they expect. We explain options, impacts, and trade-offs clearly so decisions stay aligned with your strategy. Costs are driven by complexity, transaction volume, and coordination needs; we make those drivers explicit early on. We provide reporting formats suited to your governance, with concrete indicators and actionable recommendations. When the context changes (growth, funding, restructuring), we adjust the setup without starting over.

The engagement stays centered on your priorities: compliance, efficiency, and reliable day-to-day execution. We document decisions in a clear way so each choice is defensible and continuity is preserved. Finally, we outline the next steps so the post-engagement phase is smooth and improvements remain durable.
